clauses.quote: Students in grades 7-8 must pass all COUISesto be eligible to participate in extracurricular activities/competitions/performances for the following school year.
clauses.notes: OCR artifact 'COUISesto' likely means 'courses to'; imposes academic eligibility duty on students

clauses.quote: Students in grades 9-12 must, for the immediate preceding school year, have a total numerical average of 70 (including all four core courses)
earn the appropriate number of state required credits.
clauses.notes: Independent clause joined by 'and' in source; subject carried over from preceding clause

clauses.quote: Students participating in extra curricular activities will be monitored after the first nine weeks of school to determine their level of academic performance.
clauses.subject_text: Students participating in extra curricular activities
clauses.notes: Passive construction; implicit agent is school administration

clauses.quote: Students who do not meet the above referenced criteria will be placed on probation
clauses.subject_text: Students who do not meet the above referenced criteria

clauses.quote: The sponsors/coaches of the probationary students Will be required to maintain documentation on the adherence of these students to the above referenced requirements.
clauses.subject_text: The sponsors/coaches of the probationary students
clauses.notes: Coaches/sponsors are typically faculty; classified as management per policy hierarchy

clauses.quote: Students deemed ineligible at the beginning of the school year by virtue of having failed to meet the requirements outlined in the above referenced guidelines, may regain their eligibility at the end of the first semester by meeting the requirements for eligibility in the two most recently completed semesters, including summer school.
clauses.subject_text: Students deemed ineligible at the beginning of the school year by virtue of having failed to meet the requirements outlined in the above referenced guidelines
clauses.notes: Grants discretionary relief/restoration right to students under district oversight

clauses.quote: An ineligible student may not become eligible after the fifth day of each semester.
